article.headline: Lorenz has 17 in St. Thomas’ 93-61 win against Southeast Missouri State
article.description: — Jeremy Lorenz’s 17 points helped St. Thomas defeat Southeast Missouri State 93-61 on Thursday.

keywords: Southeast Missouri State Redhawks @ St. Thomas Tommies
article.story: ST. PAUL, Minn. -- — Jeremy Lorenz’s 17 points helped St. Thomas defeat Southeast Missouri State 93-61 on Thursday. Lorenz also contributed seven rebounds for the Tommies (4-3). Kendall Blue scored 15 points, going 5 of 9 (3 for 6 from 3-point range). Hayden Tibbits shot 2 of 3 from the field and 8 of 8 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. Marqueas Bell led the Redhawks (3-3) with 11 points and nine rebounds. Southeast Missouri State also got 11 points and four assists from Alonzo Clawson-Smith. P.J. Farmer finished with nine points. Up next St. Thomas plays Saturday against Milwaukee on the road, and Southeast Missouri State hosts Purdue Fort Wayne on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
